title: Pin affected critical workflows and retire pull-request write paths

phases.objective: Use the empirically available Ubuntu 24.04 hosted runner and retire embedded repository-write behavior from pull-request workflows.

e2e_journeys.actor: GitHub Actions hosted workflow scheduler and repository lifecycle guard
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: A pull request changes one of the nine affected critical workflows.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The nine allowlisted jobs request ubuntu-24.04 and the three affected pull-request workflows are read-only.
steps: Pin each allowlisted workflow from ubuntu-latest to ubuntu-24.04.
Remove Work Map dispatch and PR-body mutation from E2E reference integrity.
Remove Fanout apply and git push from the pull-request workflow while retaining report and tests.
Remove Supervisor issue reconciliation from the pull-request workflow while retaining assurance evidence.
Execute runner-label and read-only pull-request regression checks.
assertions: Exactly nine empirically affected workflows are pinned.
Pull-request E2E integrity, Fanout report, and Supervisor assurance workflows contain no write permission or repository mutation command.
No replacement Work Map publisher, branch writer, issue writer, or other mutation authority is added by this patch.
Any future restoration of write-side automation requires a separately reviewed governed tool and explicit authorization.
No Production, provider, credential, SQL, Migration Apply, database, force-push, Work Map publication, or external runtime mutation is authorized.

phases.objective: Confirm exact-head Draft and Ready jobs obtain first-step timestamps and terminal results.
Prevent reintroduction of ubuntu-latest or PR write authority into the governed allowlist.
Compare hosted allocation evidence after merge without provider or Production actions.
Retain repository CI availability while preserving runtime safety boundaries.
